o.norm: Objects of type org.apache.commons.codec.net.BCodec cannot be decoded using BCodec

i.norm: BCodec.decode(Object) only supports {@code String} inputs. Passing any other type of object (here, the codec itself) must raise a DecoderException whose message reports that the object's type cannot be decoded.
Message: "Objects of type org.apache.commons.codec.net.BCodec cannot be decoded using BCodec"
